videos.caption: APPLE FINALLY MADE A TOUCHSCREEN MACBOOK… BUT THIS DEMO TOOK AN UNEXPECTED TURN. 😳💻 On October 28, Apple officially unveiled its first MacBook Pro with a touchscreen — a major change after years of sticking with the keyboard and trackpad. The new 14-inch and 16-inch MacBook Pro models feature a tandem OLED display, 120Hz refresh rate, M5 Pro or M5 Max chips, and touch gestures that let users scroll, zoom, drag, and interact directly with apps. But in this viral clip from tech creator CarterPCs, the display appears badly damaged, showing colorful glitches when touched. It’s a look at one demo unit — not evidence that all new MacBooks have this issue. The new MacBook Pro is available to preorder now, with sales beginning November 6. The 14-inch model starts at $2,899 in the US. So, after all these years… was bringing touch to the Mac actually worth the wait? . . . . . . #apple #macbookpro #technews #appleevent
